status: ALL AWAITING OPERATOR CHOICE. Nothing below has been implemented.

rows.title: Price-data policy (must be decided before any backtest is published)

options.label: A. Official-only
options.text: Keep nfl.com locked-Thursday FanDuel lines as the only market input; publish no opening or closing values; no CLV claims.
options.risk: Cannot measure closing-line value; grading uses one lock time.

options.label: B. Licensed odds feed
options.text: License a feed that records opening and closing numbers for every market, with its terms reviewed first.
options.risk: Terms and licence need operator approval; not verifiable from this sandbox.

options.label: C. Hybrid
options.text: Official-only for grading now; a licensed feed for CLV research only, labelled separately.
options.risk: Two price series to keep consistent.

rows.recommendation: A now; decide B before any CLV claim is published.

rows.title: Leaderboard eligibility of the four backtest-gate passes (S6, S1, S7, S2)

options.label: A. Keep off the leaderboard
options.text: Show them as backtest-only candidates; no rank until prospective weeks settle (the operator's rule).
options.risk: Slower; consistent with the rule.

options.label: B. Two-stage admission
options.text: Admit the walk-forward result as stage 1 with a prospective escrow stage 2. This requires changing the operator's rule.
options.risk: Backtest numbers would appear on the leaderboard, which the rule forbids.

options.label: C. Retire
options.text: Withdraw the four strategies and keep only B0 as the shadow baseline.
options.risk: Loses the walk-forward work.

rows.title: Depth-order source (route a per-club pages, route b snap counts, or a licensed structured feed)

options.label: A. Verify route a club by club
options.text: Probe all 32 club depth routes; keep only those that load and parse. The one probed route (Texans) returns 404.
options.risk: Pages may not exist for every club.

options.label: B. Verify route b snap counts
options.text: Locate an official snap-count source for all 32 clubs; derive starter share from it.
options.risk: No official source has been confirmed to exist.

options.label: C. Licensed structured feed
options.text: Operator authorises a structured depth feed; no transcription by eye.
options.risk: Terms and provenance need review.

rows.recommendation: Run the route b discovery first (cheap), then A; C only if A and B fail.
rows.decision: Choose the order, or choose C.

rows.title: Automated, immutable availability snapshots (Wed to kickoff) with alerts

options.label: A. Scheduled GitHub Actions capture (only after rights approval)
options.text: If written authorization permits automated retrieval, run a cron job for the injury report and verified depth source, store raw bytes and SHA-256 hashes, and fail loudly on row-count or schema drift. Do not commit sensitive/raw records to the public repository.
options.risk: Permission and source terms are unresolved; no authorized all-32 depth route or private destination is configured.

options.label: B. External durable store
options.text: Same capture, stored in an external bucket outside the static site, with alert email on failure.
options.risk: Needs an account and credentials; operator must provide.

options.label: C. Manual fetches
options.text: Operator-run or session-run fetches on set days.
options.risk: Gaps in the series; breaks the no-manual-input rule.

rows.recommendation: A, with B for long-term storage.
rows.decision: Choose A, B or C, and name the alert channel.

rows.title: Public analysis layer vs private raw-data layer

options.label: A. Derived-only pending rights review
options.text: Publish only derived analysis and source links; stop adding raw row-level captures to public Git or Pages until the terms and any required written consent are reviewed.
options.cost: Low to moderate; private store must be provisioned
options.risk: Raw evidence is not visible to public reviewers.

options.label: B. Keep current publication
options.text: Continue publishing the nfl.com-derived tables.
options.risk: The terms restrict systematic retrieval/copying absent express prior written consent; project-specific permission is unresolved.

options.label: C. Authorized hybrid
options.text: After legal review and written authorization, publish only permitted extracts/derived analysis with source links; store permitted raw records privately.
options.risk: Authorization scope, retention and permitted extracts must be confirmed.

rows.recommendation: A now; move raw rows to a genuinely private store and obtain rights review before any additional collection or redistribution.
rows.decision: Choose A, B or C after rights review.

rows.title: Roster sweep before the team-level model is trusted

options.label: A. Run the 32-team sweep first
options.text: Capture each team's roster and IR status before any team-level claim; use B0 only as a team-strength baseline until then.
options.risk: Depends on S-03 and R-08.

options.label: B. Accept B0 as is, labelled
options.text: Keep B0 published as team-strength only, with the sweep listed as NOT RUN.
options.risk: Readers may over-read the baseline.

rows.recommendation: B now, A before any injury-aware claim.

rows.title: Weekly locked-line schedule and a second total estimator

options.label: A. Lock every week, publish both totals
options.text: Originate lines before each Thursday lock, publish both total estimators with the gap column, and grade after finals.
options.risk: Small samples for a long time.

options.label: B. Lock only when a market capture exists
options.text: Originate only when the nfl.com picks article is captured.
options.risk: Gaps in the record.

rows.title: Archive past-season injury reports for designation calibration

options.label: A. Probe the archive, then capture
options.text: Test whether nfl.com archive pages for past weeks exist; if they do, capture a fixed window with hashes.
options.risk: Archive may be unavailable.

options.label: B. Use 2026 only
options.text: Accept the small 2026 sample; report the calibration as not estimable.
options.risk: No power to calibrate.

rows.title: Definition of a reward for top strategies

options.label: A. Paper points only
options.text: Points on a paper leaderboard; no money; no awards until gates pass.
options.risk: Low motivation.

options.label: B. No rewards
options.text: Remove the reward concept from the leaderboard.
options.risk: Departs from the brief.

rows.decision: Choose A or B (C is not offered: money-linked rewards conflict with the repo's responsible-research policy).

rows.title: Legacy namespaces: 15 parallel dashboards and duplicate copies

options.label: A. Mark superseded, keep in place
options.text: Add a banner to each legacy root page pointing at this site; change nothing else.
options.risk: Clutter remains.

options.label: B. Move to archive/
options.text: Move legacy namespaces under archive/ (no deletion), keep links working via redirects.
options.risk: Moves can break cross-links; needs a link check.

rows.recommendation: A now; B after the operator approves.
